scope: New builds/rebuilds: flat and shaker cabinet fronts >=16 mm with outer mounting sides; wardrobes mounted on actual side/divider boundaries; side and concealed runners including inner drawers; corner carriers, bored carousel hubs, lift tubes and wardrobe lift; sliding roller axes. Bevel/glass/notched and special internal hinges retain legacy construction unless handled by their own family builder.
validation_limit: 41 sampled poses check moving vertices against cabinet structural bounds. This is not exhaustive continuous solid collision detection, self-intersection certification, load testing, or manufacturing approval. Group#copy tests SketchUp shared-definition copy semantics, not physical Ctrl+Move keystrokes.
